intent: Route target for /dashboard (container). Injects TelemetryStore and WorkoutStore (2 deps). On init: telemetry.load()+startStream(), stop on destroy (DestroyRef). Template composes app-biometric-tiles, app-comparison-split-bars, app-radial-gauge-indicator, app-phase-timeline, app-exercise-step-cards, app-statistics-bar-widget into grid areas tiles/bars/gauges/timeline/cards/stats. Gauge values derive from WorkoutStore completion (80/20 style percentages).
